name: com.dakaio/domainscout
title: DomainScout
description: Domain research for AI agents: checks hundreds of names in one call, with prices and where to buy.

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_TLDS
environmentVariables.description: TLDs tried for names given without one, comma-separated. Default: com,net,ai

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_REGISTRARS
environmentVariables.description: Registrars to show buy links for, e.g. cloudflare,porkbun,namecheap. Default: all nine

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_MAX_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Most domains per call after adding TLDs. Default: 500

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_PRICES
environmentVariables.description: Public price lists (Cloudflare, Porkbun): on or off. Default: on

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_AFFILIATE
environmentVariables.description: Affiliate buy links: on or off (off gives plain links). Default: on

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_NAMECOM_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Name.com username, to confirm free names with Name.com

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Cloudflare account id, to confirm free names with Cloudflare Registrar

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Cloudflare API token with Registrar permission

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_SPACESHIP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Spaceship API key (domains:read scope), to confirm free names with Spaceship

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINSCOUT_PORKBUN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Porkbun API key, to confirm free names with Porkbun
